about: The technology tree (decision 'Playable 24': an advanced, complex web of techs, unlocking as time goes by but still to be researched; from the Hellenistic age to the modern world). cost: research points. available_from: the year it can first be researched (history's date of invention or spread). requires: techs needed first. effects: shares added (field, orchard, herd, mine, crafts, trade, tax, manpower, integration, growth, research, siege; unrest and corruption and interest as shares added; admin as provinces; garrison as Might; reach_km in km; sea_cost as a share of sea travel cost; might_<role> as a share of that role's Might). unlocks: buildings or units that need it. Dates from the histories of ancient technology (Oleson, 'The Oxford Handbook of Engineering and Technology in the Classical World', 2008; White, 'Medieval Technology and Social Change'). Our own data, free for any use.

techs.name: Crop rotation with legumes
techs.description: Beans and vetch between the grain restore the soil (Theophrastus, Cato).
